submissions.findingTextShort: A 2024 endothelial-function meta-analysis found no significant ICAM or VCAM effect, conflicting with broader favorable pooled marker signals.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: A 2024 systematic review and meta-analysis of three randomized controlled trials involving 146 patients found no significant effect of Nigella sativa supplementation on ICAM or VCAM and reported severe heterogeneity; this narrower endothelial-function synthesis conflicts with favorable pooled endothelial-marker signals reported in a broader 2025 cardiometabolic synthesis, so downstream grading must resolve trial inclusion, population, preparation, and outcome-handling differences rather than selecting only the favorable result.
submissions.populationContext: One hundred forty-six patients across three randomized controlled trials
submissions.usageContext: Nigella sativa supplementation evaluated for endothelial-function markers ICAM and VCAM
submissions.uncertaintyNote: The synthesis is small and severely heterogeneous, but its null result is a required counterweight to broader pooled positive endothelial-marker claims.
